purpose: Help CRMs, AI agents and workflow engines expose MachineSignal as MCP-style tools and test the flow without human sales contact.

mcp_status.recommended_transport_next: hosted MCP endpoint after more sandbox evidence

machine_installation_flow.machine_action: Fetch the tool manifest and list available tools.
Clone the repository and start the local stdio adapter.
machine_installation_flow.command: git clone https://github.com/machinesignal-it/machinesignal-lead-opportunity-score.git && cd machinesignal-lead-opportunity-score && python mcp_adapter/machinesignal_mcp_server.py

machine_installation_flow.machine_action: Run the buyer-machine sandbox flow only if sandbox credits are available.

machine_buyer_test_flow: if no list exists, buy target_discovery
buy only the recommended add-on when spend policy allows it
create payment-test intent in sandbox or test mode

what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_question: Find companies or domains worth scoring for a specific commercial objective.
what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_output: Bounded target list or no-go coverage decision.
Score, confidence, decision, spend policy and recommended next product.

what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_question: Is this lead strong enough to justify the next paid action?
what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_output: Deeper opportunity explanation, false-positive risk and next-step recommendation.

what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_question: What CRM/workflow payload should be prepared after a strong lead?
what_this_sells_to_machines.machine_output: CRM record patch, task payload, webhook event, agent instructions and stop rules.

next_publication_step.recommended: Submit the MCP wrapper pack to agent/MCP directories only after another no-credit validation and one sandbox buyer-machine run pass.
next_publication_step.reason: The wrapper is publicly discoverable now, but external registry publication should happen after the latest manifest and adapter changes are verified.
